message.content:
{
  "root_causes": [
    "Policy mode incorrectly includes groups with no established facts (all 'unknown' polarity) when 'all_of' and 'any_of' are empty, violating the requirement that a group must have at least one established fact to be valid.",
    "The logic for filtering groups with no established facts only skips them if 'all_of' or 'any_of' are non-empty, failing to exclude groups with only 'unknown' polarity when both lists are empty but 'none_of' is present."
  ],
  "required_changes": [
    "Add a check to exclude groups where 'established_facts' is empty regardless of 'all_of'/'any_of' content, ensuring only groups with at least one positive/negative polarity entry are considered.",
    "Modify the group validation logic to explicitly reject groups with zero established facts before evaluating 'none_of' conditions."
  ],
  "concrete_counterexample_simulation": [
    "Input: Group C has entry with polarity 'unknown'. 'all_of'=[], 'any_of'=[], 'none_of'=[{'relation':'T','polarity':'positive'}]. Current code includes Group C because it has no 'T' fact. Expected: Group C excluded because it has no established facts (unknown polarity does not count).",
    "Input: Group with only 'unknown' polarity entries passes 'none_of' check but fails existence requirement. Current output includes it; expected output excludes it."
  ],
  "preserved_invariants": [
    "Legacy mode behavior remains unchanged: full union of eligible groups, atomic validation, and rejection of inconsistent names.",
    "Policy mode enforces name consistency per (scope, group_id) only, not across different scopes.",
    "Only eligible:true records within the exact selected scope are considered for policy evaluation.",
    "Unknown polarity entries do not establish facts and cannot satisfy 'all_of' or 'any_of' conditions.",
    "Missing facts are not treated as negative facts; 'none_of' only excludes explicitly recorded signed facts.",
    "Output schema is strictly {entities: [{name, evidence_ids}], unique_entity_count} in both modes."
  ]
}
